description: This source file defines the MessagePackCodec class, which implements serialization and deserialization of objects using MessagePack within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for writing and reading fields, deep copying objects, and type support checks, tailored for use with Orleans serialization infrastructure.

classes.name: MessagePackCodec
classes.description: A codec implementing serialization and copying using MessagePack within Orleans, supporting type filtering and schema handling.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a field value into the Orleans message pack stream, including type information and reference handling.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a value from the Orleans message pack stream, reconstructing the original object with type support and reference resolution.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Determines if a given type is supported for serialization or copying based on internal filters and attributes.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an object using MessagePack serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: IsTypeAllowed
methods.description: Specifies whether a type is permitted for serialization or copying, based on supported type checks.
